title: Admission Criteria for Larkspur Memory Care Neighborhoods
content:
The admissions office applies the following figures to every Memory Care Residency Agreement. They are set per tier and, in the current schedule, are identical for all six tiers.

| Tier | Minimum age of the resident on the move-in date (years) | Physician's written diagnosis of dementia or a related cognitive disorder required | Maximum age of the physician's admission order on the move-in date (calendar days) | Maximum calendar days between the pre-admission assessment and the move-in date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | 55 | Yes | 30 | 30 |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | 55 | Yes | 30 | 30 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | 55 | Yes | 30 | 30 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | 55 | Yes | 30 | 30 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | 55 | Yes | 30 | 30 |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | 55 | Yes | 30 | 30 |

## What each column measures

- **Minimum age** - the resident's age in whole years on the move-in date: 55 years.
- **Diagnosis** - every tier requires a physician's written diagnosis of dementia or a related cognitive disorder.
- **Admission order** - the physician's admission order may be no more than 30 calendar days old on the move-in date.
- **Pre-admission assessment** - the pre-admission memory care assessment may precede the move-in date by no more than 30 calendar days.
